cards.claim: Malika Sonnet has been listed on the focus list for the NL Gendergap maintenance project.
cards.quote: The Wikimedia project NL Gendergap maintenance has placed her on their focus list, a testament to her tireless efforts in promoting gender equality and empowering women.

cards.claim: Malika Sonnet has been listed on the focus list for WikiProject Badminton/tournament focus list.
cards.quote: In 2018, Sonnet was added to the focus list of the Wikimedia project WikiProject Badminton\/tournament focus list, a collaborative effort to improve the coverage of badminton tournaments on Wikipedia.
